name: ringcentral
description: Connect to RingCentral through its official MCP server.

research.notes: RingCentral's MCP Hub lists separate RingEX Phone, Chat and Admin servers on mcp.labs.ringcentral.com, marked Preview; the preview is open, and setup needs only a sign-in to a RingCentral RingEX account with no access request. RingEX is paid, but the Core plan (from $20 per user a month) is sold self-serve for 1 to 5 users with Buy now or a 14-day free trial that includes the full RingEX feature set, so one person can own and administer their own account; larger bundles go through sales. Sending SMS needs carrier (TCR) registration, and the pricing page does not say whether checkout asks for business details. Discovery 2026-10-09: DCR yes, CIMD no, token auth none, S256 (Chat server shown).

probe.reason: HTTP 401, sign-in methods and S256 PKCE confirmed; no account tested
